package.name: quadruped_simulator
package.description: Lightweight quadruped (legged ground robot) simulator and hardware bridge for RACER. Two executables: * cmd2base - integrates PositionCommand into SE(2) odometry with a body-frame non-holonomic motion model (forward/lateral velocity + yaw-rate clipping). Replaces poscmd_2_odom when robot_type:=quadruped. * cmd_to_twist - converts PositionCommand to geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel for real quadrupeds (Unitree Go1/Go2 etc.) that consume body-velocity commands.
